title: SAFE RLHF: SAFE REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FROM HUMAN FEEDBACK
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Large Language Models with human values, specifically helpfulness and harmlessness. It includes a multi-dimensional evaluation framework featuring 14 harm categories, such as 'Religious Discrimination', 'Hate Speech', and 'Non-Violent Unethical Behavior'. It explicitly benchmarks models against these ethical and moral categories.
